```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/code_gallery.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
section = data.get("section", {})
tutorials = data.get("tutorials", [])

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def render_tutorial(tutorial):

    title = safe(tutorial.get("title"))
    description = safe(tutorial.get("description"))
    image = safe(tutorial.get("image"))
    alt = safe(tutorial.get("alt") or tutorial.get("title"))

    tags = tutorial.get("tags") or []
    if isinstance(tags, str):
        tags = [tag.strip() for tag in tags.split(",")]

    tags_html = "".join(
        f'<span class="cw-gallery-tag">{safe(tag)}</span>'
        for tag in tags
    )

    links = []

    for key, label in [
        ("python_url", "Python"),
        ("r_url", "R"),
        ("matlab_url", "MATLAB"),
    ]:
        url = str(tutorial.get(key) or "").strip()

        if url and url.lower() != "nan":
            links.append(f"""
              <a href="{safe(url)}"
                 class="cw-gallery-link"
                 target="_blank"
                 rel="noopener noreferrer">
                {label} Tutorial
                <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
              </a>
            """)

    links_html = "".join(links)

    if not links:
        links_html = '<span class="cw-gallery-soon">Coming soon</span>'

    return f"""
    <article class="cw-gallery-card">

      <button
        type="button"
        class="cw-gallery-image-button"
        data-lightbox-src="{image}"
        data-lightbox-alt="{alt}"
        aria-label="Enlarge image: {alt}"
      >
        <img src="{image}"
             alt="{alt}"
             loading="lazy">

        <span class="cw-gallery-zoom">
          Enlarge image
        </span>
      </button>

      <div class="cw-gallery-card-body">

        <div class="cw-gallery-tags">
          {tags_html}
        </div>

        <h3>{title}</h3>

        <p class="cw-gallery-description">
          {description}
        </p>

        <div class="cw-gallery-card-footer">
          {links_html}
        </div>

      </div>

    </article>
    """

cards = "".join(render_tutorial(t) for t in tutorials)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-gallery">

  <section class="cw-gallery-hero">

    <div class="cw-gallery-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-gallery-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

      <a
        href="{safe(hero.get("button_url"))}"
        class="cw-gallery-hero-button"
        target="_blank"
        rel="noopener noreferrer"
      >
        {safe(hero.get("button_label"))}
        <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
      </a>

    </div>

  </section>

  <section class="cw-gallery-section">

    <div class="cw-gallery-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-gallery-section-label">
        {safe(section.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h2>

      <p>{safe(section.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-gallery-grid">
      {cards}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>

<dialog id="cwGalleryLightbox" class="cw-gallery-lightbox">
  <button
    type="button"
    class="cw-gallery-lightbox-close"
    aria-label="Close enlarged image"
  >
    &times;
  </button>
  <img id="cwGalleryLightboxImage" alt="">
</dialog>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  const dialog = document.getElementById("cwGalleryLightbox");
  const image = document.getElementById("cwGalleryLightboxImage");
  const close = dialog?.querySelector(".cw-gallery-lightbox-close");

  if (!dialog || !image || !close) return;

  document.querySelectorAll(".cw-gallery-image-button")
    .forEach(button => {

      button.addEventListener("click", () => {

        image.src = button.dataset.lightboxSrc;
        image.alt = button.dataset.lightboxAlt || "";

        if (!dialog.open) {
          dialog.showModal();
        }

      });

    });

  close.addEventListener("click", () => {
    dialog.close();
  });

  dialog.addEventListener("click", event => {
    if (event.target === dialog) {
      dialog.close();
    }
  });

  dialog.addEventListener("close", () => {
    image.removeAttribute("src");
  });

});
</script>
